cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small. You and I can get noodles.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. She's choosing people she sees every week. It isn't a verdict on your friendship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. That's the kindest accurate sentence. Come have one with me.

mechanism: A manages how B interprets a hurtful invitation message while offering an edited explanation and an alternative evening.
confusable: Mere avoidance of the message is insufficient; A must be protecting B and supervising interpretation rather than only hiding their own motive.
comparison: Social exclusion and shared noodles differ from technically reframing a portrait critique.
seedUse: Use choir invitation contradiction and hurtful message, with A making an overconfident scope correction to shield B.
